$comment: Isolates the mirror's multi-grid-edge drop on simbench_lv_el_dependent - the only grid it changes.

sector_from_grid returns None for a multi-grid node (its docstring: 'must be resolved by context'; a CHPHGControlNode carries [PowerGrid, GasGrid]). _branch_sector_str reads the FROM-NODE ONLY, so the 26 GenericTransferBranch stubs carrying each CHP's electrical output into its bus were tagged '' and mirror_from_monee dropped them (if not tag: continue).

Measured offline on the built grid: sector-scoped electricity reach from a CHP control node = 1 node (ITSELF); the 47-CP fleet forms 2 disjoint components, 26 CHPs (155 nodes, gas) and 21 P2H (258 nodes, electricity+heat), overlap 0. Reproduced exactly in-sim: participants={26, 21}, never 47, with sectors_in_round={1, 2} - the CHP round sees ONE sector, its gas input. A single-sector CP round has no coupling to optimise, so minimize_usage pins all 26 CHPs at r=0 under gossip AND lexicographic alike (measured: heat_mw 0.0019-0.0123, n_active 0.1-3.7 of 47). With the fallback the CHP reaches 413 nodes across all three sectors and the fleet forms one 47-CP round.
Reference points on this grid: component_level (unregulated fleet) delivers heat_mw 0.2804, heat served 0.888, PWSF 2.940; SCARE currently 0.0019-0.0123 / 0.56 / 2.53.

Scoped to the mirror on purpose - _branch_sector_str keeps its from-node reading for the line-loading monitor, reconfiguration cut and relief actuator call sites, which ask 'is this an electricity power line' and would otherwise gain 26 CHP transfer stubs.
gas_dependent is the negative control: it has no node-hosted CP, already forms one 47-CP component, and must come out bit-identical.
Judge on: participants= / sectors= in the L3 trace, outcomes__cp_generation n_active/heat_mw/el_mw, served_by_sector heat fraction, PWSF.
